claims.claim: Tesla unveiled Powercore, a solid-state medium voltage transformer rated at 7.4 MW or 9 MVA continuous output at 34.5 kV AC with 98.86 percent peak efficiency.
claims.episode_span: Tesla unveiled Powercore, a solid-state medium voltage transformer that also handles the jobs of an inverter and a circuit breaker in a single unit. The product is rated at 7.4 MW or 9 MVA of continuous output at 34.5 kV AC with grid-forming support for 10 MVA of peak power. Peak efficiency reaches 98.86 percent across a DC range of 800 to 2,000 volts.
claims.source_title: Tesla’s Powercore could change how data centers get power
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla has unveiled Powercore, a solid-state medium voltage transformer that also handles the jobs of an inverter and a circuit breaker in a single unit.
